Art of Noise (also the Art of Noise) were a British avant-garde and electronic group formed in early 1983 by audio engineer and record producer Gary Langan and programmer J.
Jeczalik, along with keyboardist and arranger Anne Dudley, producer Trevor Horn, and music journalist Paul Morley.
The group had international Top 20 hits with its interpretations of "Kiss", featuring Tom Jones, and the instrumental "Peter Gunn", which won a 1986 Grammy Award.
